selection_rationale: Selected by reading the GT and cross-checking against the ASan report (sanitizer_trace.txt) and the patch. This is a lifetime (double-free) bug, so the scored invariant is the double-free CRITERION plus the lifetime nodes (single alloc site, first free, second free) and the aliasing root cause the patch fixes. The sink is the ASan crash line (second free); the two free contexts and the single allocation context come directly from ASan; the root cause is the inline static_array->heap aliasing memcpy that the patch mitigates (PreallocedCount 8->2).

root_cause_criterion.evidence: ASan reports exactly ONE allocation of the 912-byte region 0x619000000080 (allocation_stack: realloc at hb-vector.hh:174) and TWO frees of that same address: first via fini_deep (free_stack: hb-vector.hh:63 <- fini_deep 72 <- accelerator::fini 1143 <- init 1105), then via the stale static_array copy (crash_stack: hb-vector.hh:63 <- ~hb_vector_t<CFF1FontDictValues> 44 <- ~accelerator 1010 <- _populate_gids_to_retain 156). One allocation, two owners, one double-free abort. patch_differential: vul image crashes with heap-double-free on 0x619000000080 while the fix image (PreallocedCount 8->2, which shrinks the inline static_array store whose 168 migration memcpy aliases the owning OpStr pointer) exits 0 on the IDENTICAL PoC (md5 3b6e86dae36c51cad1eea927e15f39b7). The root_cause site (aliasing memcpy at 168) is not itself on any ASan stack (it has returned by crash time); it is the deduced mechanism confirmed indirectly by the single-alloc/double-free invariant and directly by the patch differential.

nodes.evidence: accelerator_templ_t::init frames appear on BOTH the ASan free_stack (frame at hb-ot-cff1-table.hh:1105) and allocation_stack (frame at 1105), so init unquestionably executed. reference_table<cff1>(face) at line 1018 is the entry precondition for init to obtain `blob` and proceed to the CFF cast/interpret; the function is witnessed. Exact line-1018 source-coverage precision is deferred (needs an llvm-cov/gcov rebuild), but function-level reachability is witnessed.

The CID-keyed path was taken: the ASan allocation_stack contains DictInterpreter<CFF1FontDictOpSet, CFF1FontDictValues, ...>::interpret (hb-cff-interp-dict-common.hh:290) reached from init at hb-ot-cff1-table.hh:1105. The CFF1FontDict interpreter is only entered on the CID FDArray path, which requires fdCount to have been read (>0) at line 1063. Exact line-1063 coverage precision deferred; CID-path admission is witnessed by the CID-specific interpret frame.

hb-ot-cff1-table.hh:1105 (font_interp.interpret(*font)) is DIRECTLY on the ASan allocation_stack (frame 6) AND the free_stack (frame 4). The interpret call at 1105 both allocates the doomed OpStr buffer and, on its failure branch, calls fini() -> first free. Witnessed at exact line.
hb-cff-interp-common.hh:631 (values.push()) is on the ASan allocation_stack (frame 4) as the caller of the OpStr vector growth. Witnessed at exact line.

hb-vector.hh:174 (realloc) is the ASan allocation_stack frame 1 for the 912-byte region 0x619000000080 that is later double-freed. This is the single, sole allocation of the object. Witnessed at exact line.

The aliasing memcpy at line 168 is not on any ASan stack (it has returned by crash time), but its effect is witnessed (single alloc, two frees of the same address = pointer aliasing must have occurred) and the mechanism is confirmed by patch_differential: the fix changes exactly this inline static_array store (PreallocedCount 8->2 at hb-vector.hh:34) and eliminates the crash. Line-168 coverage precision deferred (needs rebuild); the causal mechanism is runtime-confirmed.
First free: ASan free_stack frame 1 = hb-vector.hh:63, reached via fini_deep (72) <- accelerator::fini (hb-ot-cff1-table.hh:1143) <- init (1105). Witnessed at exact line.

Second free = the crash. ASan crash_stack frame 1 = hb-vector.hh:63, reached via ~hb_vector_t<CFF1FontDictValues> (44) <- ~accelerator_templ_t (hb-ot-cff1-table.hh:1010) <- _populate_gids_to_retain (hb-subset-plan.cc:156). ASan aborts here: 'attempting double-free on 0x619000000080'. Sink == crash line: confirmed.

edges.evidence: Consecutive frames on the ASan allocation_stack (1105 -> 290 -> 631).
Consecutive frames on the ASan allocation_stack (631 -> 134 push -> 192 resize -> 174 alloc).

edges.via: the allocated OpStr pointer becomes a field of a CFF1FontDictValues element that is then bytewise-copied by the fontDicts static_array->heap migration
edges.evidence: The single allocated region (174) is duplicated by the aliasing copy; witnessed indirectly by the single-alloc/double-free invariant and confirmed by patch_differential. Line-168 line coverage deferred.

edges.via: aliased heap copy freed first through fontDicts.fini_deep()
edges.evidence: ASan free_stack: the aliased buffer is freed via fini_deep at hb-ot-cff1-table.hh:1143 on the init error path (1105).

edges.via: double_free of 0x619000000080: stale static_array element re-freed at scope-exit ~hb_vector_t (44) <- ~accelerator (1010)
edges.evidence: ASan: 'attempting double-free on 0x619000000080' with an explicit 'freed by thread T0 here' (fini_deep) preceding the crash free (~hb_vector_t). The order edge free->second-free is exactly the double-free ASan reports.

edges.via: blob -> CFF cast -> CID dispatch -> per-font-dict interpret
edges.evidence: Same function (init) witnessed at 1105/1143 on the ASan stacks; the blob load at 1018 is the entry precondition. Line-1018 -> line-1105 intra-function data flow line-coverage is deferred, but init execution is witnessed.

notes: No selected node or edge was refuted. All lifetime nodes (single alloc, both frees, sink) are witnessed by ASan; the aliasing root cause is confirmed by the single-allocation/double-free invariant plus patch_differential (vul crashes, fix exits 0 on the identical PoC).

Line-level source coverage for source (1018), parser_admitted (1063) and root_cause (168) is deferred (line_precise:false): it would require an llvm-cov/gcov rebuild in the arvo container, slow under qemu (arm64->amd64). Function-level / mechanism reachability for all three is witnessed at runtime, so nothing is asserted without evidence.

GT cross-check: GT root_cause line is hb-vector.hh:168 (the CFF1FontDictValues aliasing memcpy); the patch changes hb-vector.hh:34 (PreallocedCount default 8->2). These are the SAME inline-static_array-store mechanism (the patch shrinks the inline store that the memcpy at 168 shallow-copies), so the root_cause is a valid alternative framing that the patch supports. No GT defect.
